added_lines: please pray for the repose of the souls of: christine curran jack knight margaret knight may they rest in peace sacrament of marriage we congratulate sarah kennedy & ryan hegarty who celebrated the sacrament of marriage recently in the cathedral may god bless you abundantly in love, joy and happiness sick visitation fr paul farren will attend the sick and housebound in his care on monday and wednesday. st eugene's cathedral (templemore)

called to serve: a day of support and inspiration for parish ministry on saturday 21st november from 10am to 3.00pm in knock shrine. are you involved in ministry in your parish, or interested in becoming more involved? join us at knock shrine for a day of encouragement, learning, and sharing. whether you are a minister of the eucharist, minister of the word, sacristan, in your parish choir, interested in developing a sensory mass, or looking for ways to engage young people more actively in parish life, this day is for you. come together with others involved in parish ministry to gain practical ideas, share experiences, and maybe be a little inspired! for more information visit
